parts.text: A train of mass 1.8 × 10 5 kg is at rest in a station. At time t = 0, the train begins to accelerate along a straight, horizontal track and reaches a speed of 20 m / s at t = 15 s. The train continues at a speed of 20 m / s for 10 s. At t = 25 s, the driver applies the brakes and the resistive force on the train causes it to decelerate uniformly to rest in a further 24 s.
